stem:
The figure shows a shaded triangle inside a square.

[Image: A shaded triangle inside a square]

What is the area of the shaded triangle?

Answer: ____

codes.response: Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

scoring_notes: Note: There is no distinction made between responses with or without units.
figure_description: A square containing a shaded gray triangle. The base of the triangle lies along the bottom edge of the square, extending from the bottom-left corner to the bottom-right corner. The top vertex of the triangle lies on the top edge of the square. A dimension line above the top edge divides it into two segments: the segment to the left of the vertex is labeled "4 cm", and the segment to the right is labeled "2 cm". A vertical dimension line along the right edge of the square is labeled "6 cm". Together, the top segment lengths equal the side length of 6 cm.
